description.text: The other expansion that opened the XY series on 13 December 2013, released together with Collection X. Its headline is the legendary Yveltal as a Pokémon-EX, joined by Blastoise-EX and its Mega Evolution M Blastoise-EX, and by Emolga-EX, whose attack can knock out Yveltal-EX in one hit. Like Collection X it carries the new Fairy type and the first Mega Evolutions. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Blastoise-EX, Emolga-EX and Yveltal-EX. In English most of its cards came out in XY in February 2014.
